_scope: LIVE targets = self-contained interactions only (focus / filled / reveal / selected). Form-controlled states (error / loading / disabled / countdown-end) are NOT reachable by touching one field — login.tsx validates on submit and passes an `error` prop down. Verify those in the states-harness route (Principle 4), where each field is rendered directly in its error/loading variant. The live probe verifies the screen *behaves*; the harness verifies each state *looks* right.
_note: Snapshot the bordered field container (carries border/bg/glow); drive the inner <input>. RNW renders TextInput as <input>, a direct child of the styled View, so `div:has(> input[...])` selects the container. expect = the Figma 02_聚焦 variant token (focus border #EABB62 = border-primary).

arg._revealNote: set revealSelector to the eye toggle's testID once confirmed in DOM; reveal asserts input type flips password->text

_buttonNote: Submit button intentionally has NO live-probe state: the Figma button master defines only 默认/加载/禁用 (no press affordance). Its default look is static-verified; 加载 (loading) + 禁用 (disabled) are form-controlled → states-harness, not the live probe. So nothing self-contained to drive here — omitted rather than over-asserting a press state the design doesn't define.
